mapper.select: /* Attd13Mapper.selectLeaveUseTarget */ SELECT U.LEAVE_ID AS leaveId , U.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , U.SITE_CD AS siteCd , U.USER_CD AS userCd , U.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , U.GRANT_ID AS grantId , U.START_DATE AS startDate , U.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , U.LEAVE_STATUS AS leaveStatus , U.REQ_ID AS reqId , R.LEAVE_TYPE AS reqLeaveCd , U.START_TIME AS startTime , U.END_TIME AS endTime , U.LEAVE_MINUTES AS leaveMinutes , U.PROMOTION_STAGE AS promotionStage , U.DESIGNATOR_TYPE AS designatorType , U.ORIG_DESIGNATED_DATE AS origDesignatedDate , U.LEAVE_REASON AS leaveReason , U.EVIDENCE_FILE_ID AS evidenceFileId FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U LEFT JOIN TB_USER_ATTD_REQ R ON R.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND R.REQ_ID = U.REQ_ID WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.LEAVE_ID = #{leaveId} AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' LIMIT 1

/* Attd13Mapper.selectMovableLeaves */ SELECT U.LEAVE_ID AS leaveId , U.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , U.START_DATE AS startDate , CASE WHEN U.REQ_ID IS NULL THEN U.LEAVE_DAYS ELSE ( SELECT SUM(S.LEAVE_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE S WHERE S.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND S.REQ_ID = U.REQ_ID AND S.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND S.DEL_YN = 'N' ) END AS leaveDays , U.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , U.PROMOTION_STAGE AS promotionStage , U.DESIGNATOR_TYPE AS designatorType , G.AVAIL_TO_DATE AS availToDate FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE U LEFT JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_GRANT G ON G.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND G.GRANT_ID = U.GRANT_ID WHERE U.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND U.USER_CD = #{userCd} AND U.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND U.DEL_YN = 'N' AND U.START_DATE >= #{todayYmd} AND ( U.REQ_ID IS NULL OR U.LEAVE_ID = ( SELECT MIN(X.LEAVE_ID) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE X WHERE X.CMPNY_CD = U.CMPNY_CD AND X.REQ_ID = U.REQ_ID AND X.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND X.DEL_YN = 'N' ) ) ORDER BY U.START_DATE ASC, U.LEAVE_ID ASC

/* Attd13Mapper.selectChangeRequest */ SELECT R.CHANGE_REQ_ID AS changeReqId , R.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , R.SITE_CD AS siteCd , R.TARGET_USER_CD AS targetUserCd , TU.USER_NM AS targetUserNm , R.TARGET_LEAVE_ID AS targetLeaveId , LU.START_DATE AS targetStartDate , R.INITIATOR_TYPE AS initiatorType , R.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , R.MOVE_TARGET_DATE AS moveTargetDate , R.REQ_REASON AS reqReason , R.WORKER_RESPONSE AS workerResponse , R.RESPONSE_REASON AS responseReason , R.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason , R.REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus , R.INITIATOR_USER_CD AS initiatorUserCd , R.CONFIRM_USER_CD AS confirmUserCd , DATE_FORMAT(R.CONFIRM_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS confirmDate , DATE_FORMAT(R.INSERT_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS insertDate
, LU.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , LT.LEAVE_NM AS leaveNm , LU.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(LU.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', LU.USE_UNIT_TYPE, 'SYS025') AS unitNm , LU.START_TIME AS startTime , LU.END_TIME AS endTime , CASE WHEN LU.REQ_ID IS NULL THEN LU.LEAVE_DAYS ELSE IFNULL( ( SELECT SUM(X.LEAVE_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE X WHERE X.CMPNY_CD = LU.CMPNY_CD AND X.REQ_ID = LU.REQ_ID AND X.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND X.DEL_YN = 'N' ) , LU.LEAVE_DAYS ) END AS leaveDays , LU.LEAVE_MINUTES AS leaveMinutes FROM TB_LEAVE_CHANGE_REQUEST R LEFT JOIN TB_USER TU ON TU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND TU.USER_CD = R.TARGET_USER_CD LEFT JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_USE LU ON LU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND LU.LEAVE_ID = R.TARGET_LEAVE_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT LT ON LT.CMPNY_CD = LU.CMPNY_CD AND LT.LEAVE_CD = LU.LEAVE_CD WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND R.CHANGE_REQ_ID = #{changeReqId} AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' LIMIT 1

/* Attd13Mapper.selectPendingConsents */ SELECT R.CHANGE_REQ_ID AS changeReqId , R.CMPNY_CD AS cmpnyCd , R.SITE_CD AS siteCd , R.TARGET_USER_CD AS targetUserCd , TU.USER_NM AS targetUserNm , R.TARGET_LEAVE_ID AS targetLeaveId , LU.START_DATE AS targetStartDate , R.INITIATOR_TYPE AS initiatorType , R.REQ_TYPE AS reqType , R.MOVE_TARGET_DATE AS moveTargetDate , R.REQ_REASON AS reqReason , R.WORKER_RESPONSE AS workerResponse , R.RESPONSE_REASON AS responseReason , R.REJECT_REASON AS rejectReason , R.REQ_STATUS AS reqStatus , R.INITIATOR_USER_CD AS initiatorUserCd , R.CONFIRM_USER_CD AS confirmUserCd , DATE_FORMAT(R.CONFIRM_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS confirmDate , DATE_FORMAT(R.INSERT_DATE, '%Y%m%d%H%i%s') AS insertDate
, LU.LEAVE_CD AS leaveCd , LT.LEAVE_NM AS leaveNm , LU.USE_UNIT_TYPE AS useUnitType , FNC_CMM_INFO_SRCH(LU.CMPNY_CD, 'SYST_VAL', LU.USE_UNIT_TYPE, 'SYS025') AS unitNm , LU.START_TIME AS startTime , LU.END_TIME AS endTime , CASE WHEN LU.REQ_ID IS NULL THEN LU.LEAVE_DAYS ELSE IFNULL( ( SELECT SUM(X.LEAVE_DAYS) FROM TB_USER_LEAVE_USE X WHERE X.CMPNY_CD = LU.CMPNY_CD AND X.REQ_ID = LU.REQ_ID AND X.LEAVE_STATUS = 'CONFIRMED' AND X.DEL_YN = 'N' ) , LU.LEAVE_DAYS ) END AS leaveDays , LU.LEAVE_MINUTES AS leaveMinutes FROM TB_LEAVE_CHANGE_REQUEST R LEFT JOIN TB_USER TU ON TU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND TU.USER_CD = R.TARGET_USER_CD LEFT JOIN TB_USER_LEAVE_USE LU ON LU.CMPNY_CD = R.CMPNY_CD AND LU.LEAVE_ID = R.TARGET_LEAVE_ID LEFT JOIN TB_LEAVE_TYPE_MGMT LT ON LT.CMPNY_CD = LU.CMPNY_CD AND LT.LEAVE_CD = LU.LEAVE_CD WHERE R.CMPNY_CD = #{cmpnyCd} AND R.TARGET_USER_CD = #{targetUserCd} AND R.REQ_STATUS = 'REQUESTED' AND R.INITIATOR_TYPE = 'ADMIN' AND R.DEL_YN = 'N' ORDER BY R.INSERT_DATE DESC, R.CHANGE_REQ_ID DESC
